era_resolution: The legacy system operated through fragmented ecclesiastical structures where competing centers of authority each claimed exclusive legitimacy while simultaneously identifying their rivals as the predicted Antichrist figure. The system lacked any neutral verification mechanism, causing truth claims to become entirely dependent on institutional allegiance rather than objective criteria. Persecution became the primary tool of argument, hardening identities around opposition rather than shared foundation. Textual transmission suffered from partisan editing and selective citation, further degrading the common reference standard.
